spans.v: — Free-moving, overlapping windows. You place each window anywhere, drag its title bar to move it, and drag its edges or corners to resize it. Windows can sit on top of one another.
. Windows live side by side in columns; nothing overlaps, and the strip scrolls left and right when there are more columns than fit on screen.
The window mode is a per-host setting (one tab per broker), so each host can be in its own mode.

spans.v: Disabling the mod is a different thing from hiding the pager, and much bigger.
Hide the workspace pager from the taskbar

Nothing is destroyed and nothing is hidden either way. Every tiled column lives on the one desktop the tiling core owns — workspaces only decide which of them the strip draws. Disable the mod (Control Panel → Mods) and:
every column from every workspace appears together on a single desktop;
the seven workspace shortcuts leave the Keyboard shortcuts list (your bindings are remembered, not deleted);
leave the title-bar menus, and the whole workspace block leaves the empty-desktop / taskbar menu;
any floating window that was masked to another workspace becomes visible.
